'''Little Lion''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a member of the [[Mountain Cloud Boys]] sub-sect of the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]] based in [[San Fierro]], where he also lives. He speaks in his [[The Da Nang Thang|only in-game appearance]], although the voice actor is not credited.

==Character history==
Little Lion, at an unknown time, joined the [[Mountain Cloud Boys]] sub-sect of the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]] and became an able helicopter pilot. He is asked by Triad [[Gang Leaders|Dai Dai Lo]], [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]], to fly a helicopter around a [[Da Nang Boys]] freight ship in the San Fierro bay while [[Guppy]] fires a [[Minigun|minigun]] to cause as much damage as possible. Woozie's friend and protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] volunteers to take Guppy's place, [[The Da Nang Thang|managing to cause damage on the ship before the helicopter is shot down]] by a [[Rocket Launcher|rocket propelled grenade]], killing Little Lion and wounding Carl, who manages to survive the blast and attack the ship.

==Trivia==
*Little Lion appears to know Carl, suggesting that they had met prior to the [[The Da Nang Thang|mission]] despite not appearing together in any other [[Missions in GTA San Andreas|mission]].
